decisions: resource_admission vs cast_plan: cast_plan.py takes CastPlan, _resolve_cast_plan and the shared admission skeleton (_cast_admission_events, _resource_timeline, _CastAdmission); resource_admission.py keeps only the router _apply_resource_limits. Both walks read the skeleton and the router calls both walks, so any other split is a cycle.
event_ledger vs damage_ledger: fight/ledger/event_ledger.py, matching the plan's event_rows sibling.

RotationResult: fight/results.py, not cast_slots.py. AbilityItemApplication moves there too, because RotationResult names it and _damaging_cast_times in cast_slots.py names RotationResult (cycle otherwise).
_finite_numeric_receipt: fight/ledger/event_rows.py (35 in-file readers), imported by after/lethality_windows.py.
_periodic_damage_events: fight/rotation/dot_ticks.py (the tick splitter of a damage-over-time total), imported by items/burns.py.

DEFAULT_CAST_ORDER moves to fight/cast_slots.py despite the brief's residue list: setup/combat_state.py and ledger/pool_walk.py read it, and a moved module may not import the residue. Its three readers (rotation_resolver.py and two tests) repoint.

fight/autos/swing_profile.py is one module the roster does not name (map B section S10c): _find_auto_attack_override, _basic_attack_true_rider, _on_hit_effectiveness, _auto_swing_bonus_ad. Folded into simulation.py they would make a 637-line module holding symbols five other modules read, which is a new #27 finding.

_damaging_cast_times goes to fight/cast_slots.py and _item_proc_precision with _CERTIFIED_CAST_PRECISIONS to fight/ledger/event_rows.py: both are read from three or four subpackages, and both maps call them kernel symbols with no section of their own.
FerocityTimeline goes to fight/results.py, not stacks/rengar.py: FightState annotates it and stacks/rengar.py builds it.

fight/ledger/breakdown.py holds only _is_auto_stream_key, because the brief keeps split_auto_vs_ability and split_by_damage_type in the residue and two rune modules read the predicate. No external reader imports _is_auto_stream_key, so nothing repoints.

string_annotations_that_stay_strings.src/calculator/fight/state.py: FightStat: importing rotation/stack_timeline closes state -> stack_timeline -> autos/swing_schedule -> state

string_annotation_imports_that_are_safe: fight/mitigation.py, fight/rotation/cast_parts.py, fight/autos/decaying_health_walk.py, fight/autos/empower_windows.py and fight/rotation/cast_schedule.py name FightState only in string annotations; fight/autos/empower_windows.py and fight/rotation/cast_schedule.py name RotationResult the same way; fight/state.py names BurstSwingSchedule and FerocityTimeline. Each of these may become a real import without closing a cycle, and ruff F821 resolves forward references, so the run imports them.
